activate_confirm_desc: The item will be selectable again on new documents. Its stock, variants and history are unaffected.
deactivate_confirm_desc: The item stays in all reports and past documents but can no longer be picked on new ones. You can reactivate it any time.
margin_percentage_description: Margin percentage is the percentage of the sale price that is profit. For example, if the margin percentage is 10%, the sale price will be 10% more than the purchase price or average cost. This will only be applied if the sale price is not set.
print_barcode_description: Select items, set quantities, preview barcode labels, and print them.
add_product_placeholder: Type product name, code, or barcode...
preview_description: This area shows the barcode labels exactly as they will be printed.
no_barcode_items: Only products with a saved barcode can be printed. A product with variants prints one label per variant, each with its own barcode.
no_items_selected: Add one or more items to preview barcode labels.
barcode_not_available: This item does not have a saved barcode.
barcode_total_limit_description: The combined quantity across all selected items cannot be more than {limit}. Remaining labels: {remaining}.
barcode_total_limit_error: The total number of barcode labels cannot exceed {limit}.
add_multiple_items_quickly: Add multiple items quickly. Use the “+” on the last row to append more.
remove_unwanted_items: Remove unwanted items using the “-” symbol.
duplicate_store_batch_expiry: This store with the same batch and expiry already exists.
sale_price_less_than_purchase_price: Sale price cannot be less than purchase price.
cost_and_purchase_price_required_descrip: Cost and Purchase Price are required for the opening of the item.
no_data_to_save: No data to save. Please fill at least one row.
is_batch_tracked_desc: Enable batch tracking for the item.
is_expiry_tracked_desc: Enable expiry tracking for the item.
is_color_tracked_desc: Enable color tracking for the item.
is_size_tracked_desc: Enable size tracking for the item.
color_warning: If you enable color tracking, you can't edit it once it is created.
size_warning: If you enable size tracking, you can't edit it once it is created.
opening_lock_warning_description: Some of the openings of this item are locked because these records are already in use and you can't edit them.
opening_locked_cannot_update: This opening balance cannot be updated because it has been used in transactions.
opening_locked_issued: Stock has been issued from this opening.
opening_locked_posted: This opening has already been posted.
batch_warning: If you enable batch tracking, you can't edit it once it is created.
expiry_warning: If you enable expiry tracking, you can't edit it once it is created.

opening_warning.title: Opening Warning
opening_warning.description: Be careful to enter real opening quantities. If you enter wrong quantities, you can't edit them after they are used.

opening_key_points.1: Be careful to enter real opening quantities.
opening_key_points.2: If you enter wrong quantities, you can't edit them after they are used.
opening_key_points.3: Be careful to select the correct warehouse.
opening_key_points.4: You can't edit the unit measure once the opening is posted.
opening_key_points.5: If you enable batch tracking, you can't edit it once it is created.
opening_key_points.6: If you enable expiry tracking, you can't edit it once it is created.

pricing_search_placeholder: Search by name, code or barcode...
variant_hint: The starred variant is used when no specific one is chosen. Each variant has its own SKU, barcode and price.
serial_warning: Each unit is recorded individually with its own serial number and cost.

validation.single_default_variant: Only one variant can be the default.
validation.duplicate_variant: Another variant already has these attributes.
validation.duplicate_variant_field: This :field is used by another variant.
validation.opening_price_required: A unit price is required when an opening quantity is entered.
validation.opening_warehouse_required: A warehouse is required when an opening quantity is entered.
validation.opening_variant_required: Select which variant this opening quantity belongs to.
validation.variant_max_below_min: Maximum stock cannot be below minimum stock.

hint.is_stockable: Uncheck for services that hold no stock.
hint.is_weighted: Quantity is entered as a weight rather than a count.
hint.allow_negative_stock: Permit issuing more than is on hand.
hint.show_in_pos: List this item in the point-of-sale (till) catalogue.
hint.weight: Unit weight. Also used to allocate landed costs (freight, duty, clearing) across a purchase by weight.
hint.costing_method_fallback: Leave blank to use the company method ({method}).
hint.min_shelf_life_percent: Reject deliveries arriving with less life remaining than this.
hint.shelf_life_days: Used to fill the expiry date automatically on receipt.
hint.lead_time_days: Days between ordering and receiving, used for reorder points.
hint.code: Generated automatically. It identifies the item internally and cannot be changed.
hint.item_type: Whether this is a stocked item or a service. Cannot be changed once a transaction is posted.
hint.asset_account: The account that carries this item's stock value on the balance sheet.
hint.income_account: Where this item's sales revenue is booked.
hint.cost_account: Where the cost of goods sold is booked when this item is sold.
hint.fast_search: A short alias you can type on sales/purchase lines to find this item quickly.
hint.is_batch_tracked: Track stock by batch number. Permanent once a transaction is posted.
hint.is_expiry_tracked: Track stock by expiry date. Permanent once a transaction is posted.
hint.is_serial_tracked: Each unit is recorded individually with its own serial number.
hint.variant_attributes: The choices that make each variant distinct — e.g. RAM, storage, colour, size.
hint.variant_default: The starred variant is used when no specific one is chosen (barcode scans, price lookups).
hint.variant_margin: A helper: fills the sale price from purchase price + this margin. Not stored.
hint.opening_unit_price: The cost per unit of this opening stock. Drives the item's average cost.
hint.opening_variant: Which variant this opening quantity belongs to.

confirm_save_description: You are about to create {items} item(s), {openings} of them with opening stock worth {value}. Opening stock and its accounting entry cannot be undone from this screen.
fast_entry_tip_scope: This screen is for the essential fields only — everything else (accounts, photo, variants, reorder levels) can be filled in later from the item edit form.
fast_entry_tip_keyboard: Arrow keys move between cells, Enter jumps to the next row, and Tab to the next column. On the expiry cell, Enter opens the calendar. A new row is added automatically when you type in the last one.
fast_entry_tip_defaults: The code and barcode are generated for you. Typing a name selects the default unit, and typing an opening amount selects the main warehouse.
fast_entry_tip_cost: Final cost is the purchase price plus freight, duty and clearing. It is what the opening stock is valued at; leave it empty and the purchase price is used.
fast_entry_tip_columns: Hide the columns you do not need from Column settings — the choice is remembered in this browser only.
fast_entry_tip_empty: Rows left completely empty are skipped, so you never have to clear the extra ones.
final_cost_hint: Final cost is what one unit really costs you — the purchase price plus freight, duty and clearing. Opening stock is valued at it. Leave it empty and the purchase price is used.
fix_errors: Please fix the highlighted cells before saving.
measure_required_in_row: Row {row}: the unit measure is required.
warehouse_required_in_row: Row {row}: choose a warehouse for the opening amount.
quantity_required_in_row: Row {row}: enter an opening amount for the batch/expiry you typed.
duplicate_name_in_row: Row {row}: this name is used more than once.
expiry_open_hint: Press Enter or click to open the calendar
fast_opening_tip_scope: This screen sets the stock you already hold, for items that have no opening yet. An item disappears from the list once its opening is posted.
fast_opening_tip_once: Opening stock is a one-time, go-live figure. After this, stock only moves through purchase, sale, transfer and adjustment.
fast_opening_tip_skip: Leave the opening amount empty on anything you are not counting — those rows are skipped, so you never have to delete them.
fast_opening_tip_cost: Final cost is what one unit really costs you — the purchase price plus freight, duty and clearing. It values the stock and the accounting entry it creates.
fast_opening_tip_keyboard: Arrow keys move between cells, Enter jumps to the next row, and Tab to the next column. On the expiry cell, Enter opens the calendar.
fast_opening_tip_locked: Batch and expiry only accept typing on items that are tracked that way; on the rest they stay closed.
fast_opening_tip_page: Only the rows on this page are saved. Finish a page, save it, then move on to the next.
confirm_opening_description: You are about to post opening stock for {items} item(s), worth {value}. This creates stock movements and a balanced opening-balance voucher, and it cannot be undone from this screen.
cost_required_in_row: Row {row}: enter the final cost for the opening amount.
no_opening_to_save: Enter an opening amount on at least one item.
fast_opening_done: Every item already has an opening balance. There is nothing left to enter here.
barcode_variants_skipped: {count} variant(s) have no barcode and were left out.
barcode_heading_hint: Printed once at the top of the sheet — a shop name, a batch reference.
barcode_filter_placeholder: Filter by name, code, barcode or category
barcode_already_listed: That product is already in the list — it has been ticked for you.
barcode_over_limit: You have {count} labels, more than the {limit} this screen prints at once. Lower a quantity or untick a row.

barcode_symbology_rules.CODE128: Accepts letters, digits and symbols — any length. The safe default for codes this system generates.
barcode_symbology_rules.CODE128A: Uppercase letters, digits and symbols. No lowercase.
barcode_symbology_rules.CODE128B: Upper and lowercase letters, digits and symbols.
barcode_symbology_rules.CODE128C: Digits only, and an even number of them — it encodes them in pairs.
barcode_symbology_rules.EAN13: Exactly 13 digits, the last being a valid check digit. A GS1 retail code, not one you invent.
barcode_symbology_rules.EAN8: Exactly 8 digits, the last being a valid check digit. A GS1 retail code, not one you invent.
barcode_symbology_rules.UPC: Exactly 12 digits, the last being a valid check digit. A GS1 retail code, not one you invent.
barcode_symbology_rules.CODE39: Uppercase letters, digits and - . $ / + % and space.
barcode_symbology_rules.ITF14: Exactly 14 digits, the last being a valid check digit. Used on shipping cartons.
barcode_symbology_rules.codabar: Must start and end with A, B, C or D, with only digits and - $ : . + / in between.
